tasks.title: Stabilize bone-conduction output routing
tasks.description: Ensure audio is reliably routed to bone-conduction output and avoid fallback to hardware speaker unless explicitly configured.
acceptance: When bluetooth is connected, output prefers bluetooth route.
No unintended speaker leak in normal connected case.
verification: Runtime route logs show bluetooth-selected path when connected.

tasks.title: Reduce poster-to-person false positives
tasks.description: Reduce cases where poster images of people are announced as real nearby persons.
acceptance: Static poster faces are less likely to trigger person-avoidance alerts.
verification: Replay/frame test with poster scene shows suppressed or downgraded person alert.

tasks.title: Improve stair/step detection reliability
tasks.description: Increase detection robustness for up/down stairs and step edges.
acceptance: Stair-related cues appear consistently in staircase scenes.
verification: Stair scene replay shows stable stair guidance.

tasks.title: Add glass door/window handle and switch localization
tasks.description: Support guidance for glass doors/windows with handles and nearby light switches.
acceptance: Glass structure cues are announced with direction when visible.
verification: Sample frames produce glass/handle/switch guidance text.

tasks.title: Add stair handrail guidance
tasks.description: Provide handrail position guidance while approaching or using stairs.
acceptance: Handrail direction is announced in stair context.
verification: Stair + handrail frames produce handrail guidance.

tasks.title: Improve indoor potted-plant obstacle detection
tasks.description: Improve potted-plant detection for indoor obstacle awareness.
acceptance: Potted plants in indoor path are detected and announced when relevant.
verification: Indoor plant test frames show potted-plant detection.

tasks.title: Recognize restroom signs/text and entry/exit direction
tasks.description: Support restroom-related sign/text recognition and directional entry/exit cues.
acceptance: Restroom sign/text can be recognized when readable.
Entry/exit directional cue is generated.
verification: OCR-driven test emits restroom/entry/exit message.

tasks.title: Improve turnstile recognition after passing gate
tasks.description: Retain or recover turnstile awareness after passing through gate area.
acceptance: Turnstile context is still recognized post-passage in valid scenes.
verification: Gate transition frames keep turnstile-related scene cues.

tasks.title: Improve blind path detection accuracy
tasks.description: Improve blind path detection stability and reduce misses.
acceptance: Blind path tracking is more stable in typical walkway scenes.
verification: Blind path replay shows improved continuity.

tasks.title: Distance broadcast without decimals, prefer steps
tasks.description: Use integer distance wording and prioritize step-based distance narration.
acceptance: Distance speech avoids decimal meters in default mode.
Step-based expression is used by default.
verification: Generated speech text uses integer steps/meters only.

tasks.title: Far obstacle policy: remind only, no avoidance action
tasks.description: For far static objects, provide reminder/safety cue without avoid-left/right command.
acceptance: Far static obstacles do not trigger directional avoidance instructions.
verification: Speech generation differentiates far reminders vs near avoidance.

tasks.title: Improve poles/hydrants/bollards/trees/sign-post detection
tasks.description: Improve recognition for common roadside vertical/static obstacles.
acceptance: Target obstacle classes are detected with better recall.
verification: Whitelist + scene tests show detections for listed classes.

tasks.title: Fix wrong-side avoidance around parked vehicles
tasks.description: Avoid advising blocked side passage when parked vehicles block pedestrian path.
acceptance: Routing advice does not suggest blocked side in representative scenarios.
verification: Crosswalk/navigation decision tests prefer feasible side.

tasks.title: Improve trash-bin/bicycle/e-bike/motorcycle obstacle detection
tasks.description: Improve detection quality for these commonly missed roadside obstacles.
acceptance: Target class announcements occur reliably when visible and relevant.
verification: Replay tests show improved detections for listed categories.

tasks.title: Improve low-fence detection
tasks.description: Improve recall for low-height fences/barriers that were previously missed.
acceptance: Low fences are detected and announced as obstacles when near path.
verification: Low-fence sample frames trigger fence obstacle output.

tasks.title: Add stop-and-gaze (>=2s) focused description mode
tasks.description: When user stops and faces one direction for >=2s, prioritize richer forward scene description.
acceptance: Sustained stop-and-gaze state triggers focused description mode.
verification: IMU/time-gated runtime test emits focused mode narration.

tasks.title: Recognize subway/bus station signs and text
tasks.description: Improve detection and OCR-based recognition for subway/bus station signage.
acceptance: Station sign/text cues are recognized when legible.
verification: Station-related scenes produce correct station cues.

tasks.title: Improve core model outputs for traffic/crosswalk/blindpath/person/stairs/turnstile
tasks.description: Improve end-to-end detection behavior for high-priority navigation entities.
acceptance: Core entities show fewer misses and better stability in replay scenes.
verification: Regression replay indicates improved detection consistency.

tasks.title: Avoidance trigger only for straight-ahead urgent/moving threats
tasks.description: Restrict active avoidance to forward critical threats or approaching objects.
acceptance: Avoidance commands are emitted only under configured critical conditions.
verification: Risk/urgency policy tests confirm trigger narrowing.

tasks.title: Suppress elevator hallucination announcements
tasks.description: Reduce false elevator announcements in non-elevator scenes.
acceptance: Elevator cues are suppressed unless scene evidence is sufficient.
verification: Non-elevator replay no longer emits elevator hallucination.

tasks.title: Persist app_main output logs to local file in realtime
tasks.description: Write app_main stdout/stderr to timestamped local files while preserving terminal output.
acceptance: App startup creates a timestamped log file under log directory.
Terminal output remains visible while file receives same output in realtime.
verification: python -m py_compile app_main.py
Short runtime start creates and appends log/app_main-*.log
